rounds.hypothesis: The hand-written 4x4 Jacobi eigensolver is numerically equivalent to cuSOLVER/eigh and can be the capture-safe GPU path.
rounds.change: Ran the extended probe on the GPU debug allocation; static-jacobi disagreed with the NumPy reference. Derived the Givens rotation sign for G=[[c,s],[-s,c]] (tan(2 theta)=2*apq/(aqq-app)) and fixed `gpu_solver.eigh4_jacobi`.
rounds.command: /home/syk/miniconda3/envs/WM/bin/python probe.py --force-cpu --B 1,8,32 --N 100 --dtypes float64 --repeats 2; plus an in-process CPU repro of the buggy sign (results/logs/jacobi_bug_cpu_repro.txt); full grid: probe.py --force-cpu --repeats 5
rounds.before: buggy static-jacobi, B=8,N=100,float64, CPU in-process reproduction: max|dR|_F=1.80, max|dt|=0.94, n_mu match 0.50 (half the instances follow a different schedule)
rounds.after: static-jacobi B=1/8/32,N=100: max|dR|_F 3.9e-16..7.5e-16, n_mu match 1.00, success 1.00; full CPU grid float64 max|dR|_F=1.64e-15, float32 worst 8.34e-7, n_mu match 1.00, 0 failures across 70 rows

rounds.hypothesis: A full grid (B={1,8,32,128,512}, N={100,500}, float64/float32) with machine-readable output is needed to compare eager dynamic, static-shape and CUDA-graph paths; the old probe's 3 print-only configs are insufficient.
rounds.change: Rewrote `probe.py`: NumPy correctness oracle, eager dynamic, static-eigh/static-jacobi, CUDA-graph wrappers, success vs GT, n_mu equality, dtype stability flag, sync-bracketed p50/p95; writes qpep_gpu.{json,md,png}.
rounds.command: sbatch --partition=gpu --gres=gpu:1 --time=00:20:00 ... probe.py --out results (job 3171; GPU blocked) and the same script --force-cpu --repeats 5
rounds.before: 3 configs (B=1,8,32; N=100/500 mixed), stdout only, no JSON/MD/PNG, no success/n_mu aggregate, no float32 check
rounds.after: 20 (B,N,dtype) cells x (numpy-ref + dynamic + static-eigh + static-jacobi) = 70 rows, 0 errors, JSON+MD+PNG in results/; dtype stable=True for float64 and float32; GPU rows blocked (see round 3)

rounds.hypothesis: CUDA-graph capture of the static-shape 4x4 eigen GNC is feasible on an RTX 5090, and graph-eigh vs graph-jacobi can be timed at B up to 512.
rounds.change: Submitted the GPU probe under Slurm (sbatch, gpu partition, gres=gpu:1, 20 min) and monitored squeue/scontrol; no GPU was free, so no capture was attempted and the CPU validation was run instead.

rounds.after: BLOCKED: node ls Gres=gpu:3, AllocTRES gres/gpu=3; jobs 3151/3094/3086 (user cyr) RUNNING for the whole session; job 3171 was PENDING StartTime=2026-11-28T21:34 and was cancelled after recording the state; duplicate job 3170 (main workspace) also PENDING StartTime=2026-11-28T21:23. Exact graph error is therefore None (graph never captured), not a reported failure. Slurm state saved in results/logs/slurm_gpu_3171_state.txt.
